title: A Slower Day
introTitle: A day without a long itinerary.
intro: After a full day aboard the Bernina Express, this day is intentionally left open. The pace slows in Brescia, with time to explore, revisit a favorite place, take an easy drive nearby or simply enjoy a quieter day before the journey continues.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: A flexible day based in Brescia with no major road trip or fixed sightseeing route.
